facts.business: Munjal Showa Limited manufactures suspension systems and components for the automotive industry, primarily serving Indian OEMs with a focus on premium motorcycle segments and developing capabilities for EV and premium vehicle platforms.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on property, plant & equipment, capital work-in-progress and intangible assets including capital advances

key_risks: Investments in digital infrastructure affecting short-term profitability
Collaborations with Soben and TFX at early stage and yet to translate into commercial supplies
Ongoing tax assessments and disputes with amounts paid under protest
